description: X5.12 acceptance. A cart on a +-0.40 m rail carries a double pendulum (planar multibond bond graph: Prismatic2D rail, two Revolute2DCompliant joints with 1e8 N/m pivots, two RigidBody2D rods of 0.25 m, 0.10/0.08 kg), driven by a 24 V DC motor through a 3:1 gearbox, a 16 mm pulley and an elastic belt; the pendulum joints are passive. The 1 kHz firmware (library/DoubleCartCtrl.jl with the tables of library/DoubleCartTraj.jl, both written by design/design.py) holds 0 V until 1 s, then tracks a direct-collocation swing-up trajectory (T_s = 2.4 s, |x| <= 0.30 m, |V| <= 16 V) with a time-varying LQR, switches to the discrete LQR at 3.4 s and is hit by a 40 ms, 0.28 N force pulse on the tip link at 7 s. The reference numbers are design.py's closed loop of the Lagrangian design model under the same sampled firmware (RK4); the bond-graph run reproduces it to ~3e-3 rad during the transients. The -free model releases the plant from rest at a non-trivial pose with the motor shorted (V = 0) and is compared with the design ODE sample by sample.
